info.title: nbem
info.description: Neobem: a domain specific language for generating EnergyPlus idf files.

options.name: --doe2
options.description: Parse input file in DOE-2 Building Description Language format

options.name: --deps
options.description: Print dependencies encountered in the input file to the specified file

options.name: --flags
options.description: Set flags for simulation. Multiple flags can be set, comma separated.

options.name: --objects
options.description: Print EnergyPlus objects in TSV format

options.name: --lsp
options.description: Start the language server on standard input/output

options.name: --tree
options.description: Print parse tree in Lisp format for debugging
